[Intro]
[Ebm]
This is what I brought you, this you can keep
This is what I brought, you may forget me I
promise to depart, just promise one thing
Kiss my eyes and lay me to sleep

[Verse 1]
[Ebm]
This is what I brought you, this you can keep
This is what I brought, you may forget me I
promise you my heart, just promise to sing
Kiss my eyes and lay me to sleep

[Chorus]
[Ebm]
[B]
[Ebm]
[B]Kiss my eyes and lay me to sleep

[Verse 2]
[Ebm]This is what I thought, I thought you'd need me
[B]This is what I thought, so think me naive I'd
[Ebm]promise you a heart, you'd promise to keep
[B]Kiss my eyes and lay me to sleep

[Chorus]
[Ebm]
[B]
[Ebm]
[B]Kiss my eyes and lay me to sleep
[Ebm]
[B]
[Ebm]
[B]Kiss my eyes and lay me to sleep

[Outro]
[Ebm]
